notes.content:
Hey Truckers!

We're thrilled to announce that a new, important update for Alaskan Road Truckers has just been deployed across all platforms!

This update directly responds to your valuable feedback and focuses on achievement and trophy-unlocking. We conducted an additional round of rigorous testing to ensure these fixes are robust. Your patience and understanding while we perfected this have been truly appreciated!

Here’s what you can expect with this new patch:
[list]
[*] Improved Achievement/Trophy Unlocking: We’ve refined the implementation to ensure that achievements and trophies unlock smoothly and consistently.
[*] "Good Job" Achievement More Attainable: For those hunting every last achievement, we've made the "Good Job" achievement slightly more forgiving, making it more accessible for all players.
[*] Reduced PC Storage Requirements: We've optimized the game's footprint on PC, freeing up valuable storage space for you.
[*] Revealed PC Achievements: On PC, you'll now see all available achievements, making it easier to track your progress and discover new goals.
[/list]

We're confident this update will significantly enhance your achievement hunting experience in the Alaskan wilderness.


What's Next?
We're already looking ahead! Our next major focus is a performance update. We'll share more details as we get closer.

Thank you again for being such an incredible community. Keep on trucking!

We’re thrilled to continue this journey with our incredible community. Your feedback drives our improvements, and your support motivates us to keep trucking forward.

Thank you for being part of this adventure.

notes.title: Alaskan Road Truckers - Roadmap Reveal
notes.content:
To our trucking legends both new and long time, here’s what you’ve been waiting for; a content roadmap for the future of Alaskan Road Truckers.

We heard your calls for this. It’s taken far longer than we wanted or even expected to lock the next phase of development, but we’re delighted to share it with you today. Going forward, all new content will be solely funded and released by Green Man Gaming Publishing. But enough about that, you came here to read about the future!

Today, we’re revealing Roadmap 1, featuring a mix of cosmetics, quality of life (QoL) updates and a larger content drop. While the majority of content will be premium content, we will also add free stuff for the whole community. We hope this can set the tone for future roadmaps in terms of content and cadence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/7a42129d86346f644237f937f1218041e6587bb8.jpg[/img]

We’ll update the roadmap with the full details and timings of our larger content drop, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3303510/Alaskan_Road_Truckers_Showrunner/]Showrunner[/url], in February. For now, we aren’t ready to reveal more than this tease, but for those of you who love movies and driving large trucks, we think you’ll be happy. Today we can reveal that on December 19th, we will launch the next paid cosmetic pack, [url=Alaskan Road Truckers: Truck Skin Pack 2]Truck Skin Pack 2[/url], containing 7 premium skins with 9 colour variants alongside 1 free skin with 3 colour variants for all players. We will also launch our PC demo, which features a two-hour play limit.

We believe this is the start of a new and exciting phase of Alaskan Road Trucker’s life, and we are calling on our community to clap, cheer and honk your horns in support.

notes.title: Steam Collectibles - Out Now
notes.content:
Happy September, trucking legends!

It isn't just about cruising The Last Frontier in style, adding the coolest skins to your in-game rig. We've now released collectibles for Alaskan Road Truckers, 25+ items to unlock and spruce up your Steam profile, including badges, trading cards and more. Every two hours (120 mins) of playtime rewards truckers with one of the following at random;

- One badge with 5 levels, and one foil
- 9 trading cards (Kodiak, Northern Lights, Radioactive, The American, The Classic, The Danger, The Jaws, The King of the Wastelands)
- 3 profile backgrounds
- 10 emoticons

notes.title: Alaskan Road Truckers, Patch 1.4
notes.content:
Last month we brought you patch 1.3, our biggest single update since launch, and the response from the community was as inspiring as it was heartwarming. The development team has carried that energy through to patch 1.4 which is out now.

We fixed over 100 bugs last time and made improvements to a range of areas, and we’re not slowing down. We’re optimising the game to deliver a smooth experience, improving visuals and updating the AI to make the roads feel more realistic than ever, based on the steady stream of feedback from the community.

[h1]Full patch notes:[/h1]

[h2]Optimisation[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimisation of textures, materials and light maps
[*] Optimisation of trailers, buildings and animals
[*] Optimisation of towns: Fairbanks, Palmer, Delta Junction, North Pole, and Paxson
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/d930e4c7cd891037b1bf27f2fc3323373dcfc8a2.png[/img]

[h2]Visual[/h2]
[list]
[*] Art improvements to Northern Alaskan terrain
[*] Reworked the user interface on the map screens
[*] Added the possibility to switch between light and dark UI themes
[*] Added trailer preview graphics to job descriptions
[*] Improved the look of fog and made it less dense on lower visual settings
[*] Improved the cable connecting animations
[*] Improved pop-in / draw-distance management (GPU and CPU optimization)
[*] Added company logos to container trailers
[*] Reworked the texture on dirt roads
[*] Improved the look of reflections on wet grass
[*] Made all truck skins available on all current models
[*] Lightened up all the logistic location offices during daytime
[*] Reduced the color difference between birch trees seen from afar and closer
[*] Reduced the brightness of light sources
[*] Improved the colors of traffic lights
[*] Improved the contrast and brightness on selected textures
[*] Balanced the overall contrast of the game
[*] Replaced some NPCs with better models
[*] Fixed some trucks having incorrectly applied customization components
[*] Fixed the flag flickering
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/abbdebd74d538efe7728797733ef98fd385df68e.png[/img]

[h2]Controls[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased the speed of map zoom
[*] Added new controller preset and renamed presets for more clarity (Controller steering type determines the general speed and sensitivity of truck steering. Steering correction curve determines the sensitivity and dead zones of thumbsticks)
[*] Added the possibility to bind and use the radial menu on a controller
[*] Enabled scaling truck decals when using a controller
[*] Enabled switching workshop menu tabs with L1/R1/L2/R2 when using a controller
[*] Enabled using the truck shop with a controller
[*] Tweaked controller vibrations
[*] Improved the communication of binding conflicts
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the speed of AI cars around dangerous turns
[*] Improved the overtaking behavior
[*] Fixed traffic and navigation near Fairbanks
[*] Added 35 and 45 mph speed limit signs
[*] Added a new type of AI car
[*] Added one new trailer (cement tank trailer) and new jobs
[*] Made more jobs available during the early stage of the game
[*] Made it impossible to die of exposure inside the truck when the heater is on
[*] Fixed the collision problem with the big-boy military chopper trailer
[*] Reworked the traffic ticket calculation system to make the fines more realistic
[*] Improved the placement of traffic police patrol cars
[*] Oil overfill is now communicated to the player in the workshop and via a HUD icon
[*] Added auto parts stores in Prudhoe Bay and Valdez
[*] Added bulbs to stores and enabled the player to manually fix the headlights
[*] Fixed the problem where discovering new cities would not work
[*] Enabled previewing trucks in the truck store even without having the required license
[*] Adjusted the fuel capacity of trucks in higher classes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/859a9d0c56e395ec073b65bfd6e7b406935a7fa3.png[/img]

[h2]Sound[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the sound of swaying grass and twigs breaking when driving on grass surfaces
[/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare instance of trucks disappearing from the parking spot
[/list]

If you want to chat with us in more detail about ideas or issues, our [url=https://discord.com/invite/TVWqt38]discord[/url] is a great way to keep in touch and we love to hear from our players, and you can help shape the future of Alaskan Road Truckers with your input.

notes.content:
We asked for feedback and you delivered. You asked us to listen, and today we’re delivering. The patch notes are below and this marks the first of two planned updates, with the second targeting early April, which will tackle vehicle physics, optimisation and graphics, and many other areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/4c4324cdf09b5b50b5ed72136e71dabd6eb07c07.jpg[/img]

With 2023 in the rearview mirror, we’ve reflected on the highs and lows and we’re truly excited about what we can all achieve together. 

Also, because you all keep asking, console is still happening. Things are progressing nicely and we’re all excited to discuss it in detail a little later. For now, just know that we’re still targeting an H1 24 release.

notes.title: Developer Dispatch: What to Expect in Our Next Alaskan Road Truckers Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I know we haven't talked for a long time, but we had reasons. Do you know those stories about people who "lock themselves in the garage" and work on something until they finish it? That's us. For the past two months, we've been updating Alaskan Road Truckers to address the community feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/048e9f55317915b4243d4cd12c6c34f9b849a609.png[/img]

[h2][b]AI[/b][/h2]
[b]First up was AI[/b], which has become faster, smoother, and more natural. Cars will overtake you if you drive too slowly and honk their horn if you create a traffic jam, bringing our world to life. We've improved the foliage, which now transitions much more smoothly between different levels of detail as it approaches the screen. We've increased the draw distance of distant lands - although here we haven't yet reached the target effect, the work continues and you'll see more improvements in the next patch. It’s a matter of balancing between the visuals and memory usage.

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2]
[b]We fixed more than a hundred bugs reported by you[/b]. We removed - hopefully finally - problems like the truck shooting into space or getting stuck on the base computer screen. If there are more, keep reporting them. We’re reading your posts, we’re here, and we’ve just been heads down while working to make this the very best experience for you all.

[h2][b]Optimization[/b][/h2]
[b]Optimization [/b]took place in several stages and was carried out by several "teams." First, a lot of time was spent on profiling, i.e. identifying what didn't work best and what could be improved. To do this, we consulted with the best from our gamedev backyard. We still need to finish the work in this area as well, but you will probably already notice that the game runs much smoother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/bb16cad4c201448051381997ea173ea0f66b8bc1.png[/img]

[h2][b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h2]
On top of that, we've made quite a few [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b]. You can now change the steering wheel turning speed on the controller or keyboard. We've changed the options screen so that more attention is drawn to the options most requested. We introduced a new preset for the controller, going toward more "console" solutions. All of the above, by the way, was another part of our ongoing work on the [b]console version[/b], which we will be able to talk about soon, but everything is on track and looking promising. 

At the same time, we continue to work on improving the PC version. We hope this will be reflected in your feedback. Our goal is to make ART a game worth sinking into. Are we moving in the right direction? You tell us!

We wish you a great Alaskan experience.
[b]Michal from Road Studio[/b]

notes.title: Addressing Community Feedback and Looking Ahead
notes.content:

We hope you're all enjoying your journeys through the wilds of Alaska! We wanted to take a moment to express our gratitude for your continued support and engagement with Alaskan Road Truckers. notes.title: Alaskan Road Truckers in 2024 - Trucking into the New Year
notes.content:
Hello truckers!

2024 has arrived on our doorsteps and we’re raring to go with a whole year of Alaskan trucking.

We’ve got big plans for 2024 and while we can’t get into specifics just yet - we wanted to let you know what we’re working on.

[h2][b]Goodbye 2023, Hello 2024![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/f533e523d2082d91c291fa09f565ef102c1e637e.png[/img]
Firstly, 2023 was a hell of a year for us. We went to Gamescom, had playtests, released Alaskan Road Truckers and even managed to release an expansion, DLC, seasonal events, and many patches to update and improve the Alaskan Road Truckers experience.

We’re so grateful to everyone who played Alaskan Road Truckers in 2023. We couldn’t have got here without your reviews, comments, feedback, streams, and videos. Everything you’ve shared with us has helped us refine our game, make it better, and has helped shape the future of Alaskan Road Truckers.

[h2][b]2024 Priorities[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/048e9f55317915b4243d4cd12c6c34f9b849a609.png[/img]
The New Year is a time for reflection and resolutions. That’s why we’ve decided to take a hard look at Alaskan Road Truckers and work on the areas we feel matter most that will improve the experience of playing our game.

For the moment we are pausing any work on additional content for the game while we devote all our resources to bug fixing, controller and steering wheel issues, and making sure we resolve the issues that get in-between you and the full Alaskan Road Truckers experience.

We still have plans to add to our game, from adding more customization options to more content, but we feel right now the focus has to be on the core game. The next game updates from us will be all about improving the game, not about adding extra stuff. We feel that this is the right call to make now, and we hope you agree as you see Alaskan Road Truckers get into fighting shape.
[h3]Alaskan Road Truckers on Console[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/bb16cad4c201448051381997ea173ea0f66b8bc1.png[/img]
We remain committed to releasing Alaskan Road Truckers on P55 and Xbox Series X/S consoles. We cannot share release date details just yet but we are working towards a full Alaskan Road Truckers release on console.

The priority right now is making the base game sparkle. As soon as Alaskan Road Truckers is trucking along nicely, we’ll have more definitive news for eager console truckers.

We know that this isn’t the news a lot of console players have been waiting for, but we hope to have more concrete information to share with you over the coming weeks. 

[h2][b]Have Your Say[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/d8d76b6e1b86960b6ce6d30edd5bab0606aadae1.png[/img]
We read every single one of your comments, social media posts, and what our community has to say on Discord. However, we want to make sure we’re hearing what you have to say clearly about the current state of Alaskan Road Truckers and also what we should be working on in the future.

We’ve set up a detailed questionnaire for you to fill out - it covers a variety of different areas related to the game and asks for you to relate your current experience with Alaskan Road Truckers. If you could take the time to fill it out, we’d be endlessly grateful.

notes.title: Merry Trucking Christmas + Merry Fixmas!
notes.content:
Haul haul haul, Merry Trucking Christmas!

It's that time of year where we're full of seasonal cheer, but the deliveries don't stop and neither do we. Santa Claus is out there making his rounds and the truckers of Alaska are too!

Make your Christmas a Winter Hauliday and take part in our fabulous festive Merry Trucking Christmas update - you'll be driving chrome for Christmas with Alaskan Road Truckers this year.

[h2][b]Merry Trucking Chrismas[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/2d9b12949b92d053e9746af9052b34262737ee41.png[/img]
Break out the haul-y and the ivy, it's time to celebrate a Merry Trucking Christmas! Our version of Alaska is filled with some wheel-y good seasonal stuff for you to haul, explore, see, and wear. 

Get into the Christmas spirit with us, here's everything you can expect to find:

[h3]New Xmas Truck Skin[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/9a00e6f6f5a1d23835cbebeed5d08c6509a716f3.png[/img]
Transform your rig into a festive sleigh with our brand-new Christmas truck skin. Embrace the holiday spirit as you navigate through the snowy landscapes in style.

[h3]Special Xmas Mission[/h3]
Deliver the season's joy with a special Christmas transport mission. Spread holiday cheer as you transport precious cargo to its merry destination.

[h3]Candy Cane Exhaust[/h3]
Upgrade your truck with a sweet touch! The Candy Cane Exhaust not only adds flair to your ride but also leaves a trail of holiday magic as you cruise through the Alaskan wilderness.

[h3]Xmas Tree at the Base[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/52256a505c4adfa43da750ff29e13c0fb305b82a.png[/img]
Decorate your trucking base with a festive touch. The new Xmas tree brings the holiday spirit to your headquarters, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

[h3]Xmas Sweaters for Characters[/h3]
Dress your characters in cozy Xmas sweaters. Whether you're braving the elements or taking a break at a truck stop, you'll look and feel festive all the way.

[h3]Hidden Snowmen[/h3]
Discover hidden snowmen scattered throughout the game. Screenshot them and share on our Discord for a special reward. Can you find them all?

[h3]The Great Snowman Hunt[/h3]
That's not all - out there, somewhere, a twisted snowman that's unlike any other lurks ready to be found. If you are first to find it, take a screenshot, and report back to our Discord, you can win a special prize. We'll say no more - good luck out there.

[h2][b]The Influencers are Here![/b][/h2]
Since launch (and even before launch) we've had some amazing support from brilliant influencers out there on Twitch, YouTube, and TikTok. So we decided to start paying that back!

Now you can show your support for your favorite influencers by decking out your truck with their logos as decals. Drive in style and let the world know who inspires your trucking journey.

[h2][b]Merry Fixmas![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/cb631457c1b7fd7f26dad8553e923ed818fbfce9.png[/img]
Of course, new stuff is nice but we wanted to give you one last Christmas present. 

Today's update doesn't just add a Christmas theme to the game, we've been hard at work focusing on performance issues. So if you were experiencing performance or FPS issues in the past, please try Alaskan Road Truckers again after downloading today's update and see if the game experience is better for you.

Our work on Alaskan Road Truckers is continual and we are making progress on the issues you report to us. We hope that this update will make the game much more playable for those of you who experienced issues related to performance, and we can't wait to see you back on the road enjoying the game.

If you do continue to experience performance (or other) issues, please don't hesitate to let us know. Every report helps us focus our efforts on the issues that matter to you - so please keep them coming, everything helps.

That's it for us this time. See you on the road, Christmas truckers!

notes.content:
Hello truckers!

We’ve got a gigantic truckload of updates for you today. Alaskan Road Truckers has its first full expansion filled with challenges, new locations, and much more. What’s better is that it’s free and comes along with a big update for the main game too. 

Here’s the lowdown on the Ice Roads Expansion for Alaskan Road Truckers:

[h2][b]Stay Frosty on the Ice Roads[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/0577fde4a88068f1ebdcf546ea6a1f9a855275f1.png[/img]
One of the core things we wanted to focus on in Alaskan Road Truckers is that feeling of teetering on the edge between success and disaster. That’s why our game has features like hunger, temperature, and more to make the world immersive and put you in the boots of an Alaskan trucker.

Our new expansion, Ice Roads, cranks everything up a notch. In it you’ll find a whole new area to explore that adds a ton of new roads and routes to the game, all focused around the coldest of conditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/63769fcb7e3b6bc5f62644a2739d7f47fe51e2ae.png[/img]

In addition to new routes and areas, there’s new missions, new cargo types, new mechanics, new consumables…there’s a lot of new! Check out the brand new Ice Roads Expansion trailer for a peek at what awaits you:

[previewyoutube=BkEutdic26o;full]<TRAILER LINK>

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2704590/Alaskan_Road_Truckers_Ice_Roads/

We’re proud to introduce you to the Trucking Hell cosmetic DLC, giving you a swathe of brutal and badass customization options for your player and your truck. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/d3e95746ef20b2119e6b74850da8d8f715940dfa.png[/img]

Hello truckers!

It's been a few weeks since we launched Alaskan Road Truckers, and we decided to take a moment and look back at the road behind us and give you all a sneak peek at the road in front.

We've come a long way already, and we're not stopping here. In case you've missed some of our updates or want to know what we're working on right now - here we go!

[h2][b]The Road So Far...[/b][/h2]

[h3]Trucking Legends[/h3]

[previewyoutube=RkLbHw3GWs8;full][/previewyoutube]
Our most recent update was titled [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/849100/announcements/detail/3906371681114520760]Trucking Legends[/url][/b]. It launched last week and changed up some of the ways players can experience the game.

In addition to the standard mode, players are now able to select Casual and Legend options when starting a new game. These tweak the difficulty of the core Alaskan Road Trucker experience. Casual mode makes the game a little easier, with resources being consumed less quickly and weather being easier to manage. Legend mode, however, tests your trucking skills to the limit. 

With harder missions, a tougher Winter start, and punishing weather, if you want to prove yourself out there in the harsh Alaskan Wilderness, this is the mode for you.

[h3]Patches, Patches, Patches![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/03cb1da1ac9ecba68892553d89c28c5a63c9c66c.png[/img]

Of course, we've not just added new content to the game. There's been a ton of patches released since launch all aimed at fixing and improving the issues that matter to you - our players. Your feedback and reports have helped us aim our efforts in the right direction, and we've come a long way.

That doesn't mean we're satisfied and sitting on our laurels. We are continually refining Alaskan Road Truckers, working on areas such as AI, controller issues, game-feel, optimization, and game balance. In the coming weeks and months you'll see many updates from us - all aimed at improving the core game experience.

[h2][b]Where We're Heading[/b][/h2]

[h3]Fancy Trucks and Looks[/h3]
One thing we know is important is making your truck feel like it's yours. We've already released some new cosmetic options for trucks and of course, there's the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2600800/Alaskan_Road_Truckers_Mother_Truckers_Edition/]Mother Truckers Edition DLC[/url] but we're also looking at making more.

Being a badass is part of the trucker experience and our next set of cosmetics will reflect that, with a rough 'n' ready look that'll show off your rugged style in spades.

[h3]Ice Roads are Coming[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/0973cd1a4bcfff1ce343c5edc1958a1a3a982076.png[/img]

The big update that we're focusing on right now will add more depth to the game, as well as more challenge. We spoke about it before in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/849100/view/5779865497754063927?l=english]Roadmap [/url]but we're getting closer and closer to unveiling the Ice Roads Expansion for Alaskan Road Truckers.

This expansion will put you and your truck on the edge of danger as you fight for survival against the harshest of elements. Only the toughest, bravest, and most skilled truckers will be able to succeed in these brand-new missions. With all new looks, routes, and terrain to conquer - this will take Alaskan Road Truckers to the next level.

[h3]And more...[/h3]
Our plans don't end there, we're working on more content, more ideas, and more everything. From launching on console to further expansions and DLC, we've got big plans, and we can't wait to take you along for the ride!

notes.title: Trucking Legends Update - Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello truckers!

We've just launched a brand new update for Alaskan Road Truckers. One of the key pieces of feedback has been about customizing your trucker journey, being able to choose a little more and play the game your way.

This update aims to address that. That's why we're inviting you to...

[h2][b]Become a Trucking Legend![/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=RkLbHw3GWs8;full][/previewyoutube]
The Trucking Legends Update will give you three options to choose from when you start a new game. In addition to the standard balanced normal mode, you'll also have [b]Casual [/b]and [b]Legend [/b]options to choose from.

In Casual mode you'll experience an easier time when delivering, perfect if you just want to sit back and get on with trucking. Resources will deplete less fast, the weather will be less punishing - overall it'll be a kinder expeirence.

If you want to test your skills, however, you can choose the new Legend mode. Here you'll start in the depths of winter. Weather will be harder to deal with, missions will be tougher. The game will be much harder to play, and you'll have to fight for survival to become a true Trucking Legend.

[h2][b]Trucking Legend Patch Notes[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/27ebeec3cba9ac9441f99bf1a107b8bda73189bc.png[/img]
[list][*] New game modes! (We may add more in the future)[/list]
[b]Casual[/b]
Better weather, more time for delivery and slower consumption of resources. You start in the summer.

[b]Standard[/b]
This is the intended, balanced experience.

[b]Legend[/b]
Difficult weather conditions and more demanding orders. You start in winter, with a jacket and wheel chains in your truck's equipment.

[list][*] New Legend truck skin, available in customization workshops.
[*] DLSS will now save properly after you set it and won't reset every time you launch the game. However, upon the introduction of the update, you will need to set your DLSS one final time.

[*] New controller scheme that can be selected in the Settings, offering a similar experience to other games in the genre.
[*] Fixes to the way many texts are displayed, they should not go over the border anymore.
[*] Fixed the bug that could cause a disappeareance of the truck left in the HQ.
[*] Optimization of the southern part of the map. The optimization process as a whole continues.
[*] Revamping the interior of the starting truck Westend Sorrow 420. More detail, better textures.
[*] Fixed the bug that could cause the player to freeze when sleeping at a motel or being at the HQ.
[*] Improved the way snow tracks are displayed.
[*] Fixed the XP rewards for POI photos, incl. retroactively awarding the points for pics already taken.

notes.title: Supporting Alaskan Road Truckers - The Patch Plan
notes.content:
Hello truckers!

We’ve had a busy time since the launch of Alaskan Road Truckers. With nine patches for our game since launch (and more incoming!) we thought it’d be a great time to talk to you all about what our plans are for Alaskan Road Truckers and how we’ll be supporting the game into the future.

[h2][b]Alaskan Road Truckers - The Goal[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/cb631457c1b7fd7f26dad8553e923ed818fbfce9.png[/img]
We want to make the best trucker game ever made, where you live, breathe, and survive as a trucker in one of the most punishing environments on the planet. That’s been our goal since day one and it still is today. 

It’s fair to say that we haven’t hit that goal yet. Alaskan Road Truckers is a game we’re incredibly proud of, but we know it still needs work. Technical issues, bugs, and quality of life issues have overshadowed the wonderful experience we’ve put in the core of Alaskan Road Truckers, and we recognize that this has caused disappointment for some.

We want you to know that we hear you. We know that for some players the issues affecting Alaskan Road Truckers has meant they have been unable to enjoy the game, and this is why we have been introducing rapid fixes to help those players get in the game and start trucking. Every patch has improved the game, with the core experience now being more accessible, key bugs are fixed, and for most the game should be more playable.

Of course, we have lots of work still to do, and there are key areas we will be focusing on as we continue to support Alaskan Road Truckers through the rest of 2023 - and beyond.

[h2][b]Post-Release Patch Plan[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/048e9f55317915b4243d4cd12c6c34f9b849a609.png[/img]
As mentioned above, we have been working on rapid patches for the most pressing issues. Now, we’re moving into a separate phase of our support plan, where we’ll be reducing the amount of patches we release and focusing on larger updates which will resolve more issues, to provide a more stable Alaskan Road Truckers experience. The issues we’re working on are bigger issues, ones that will take more time to resolve, and for a small team this means we’ll have to slow down a little bit to make sure we get these patches done right.

The areas we’re focusing on at the moment are:
[list][*]AI Tweaks and Improvements
[*]Optimization and Performance Enhancements
[*]Controller / Steering Wheel Improvements[/list]These are large things for us to tackle but we are making a commitment to get these issues ironed out and make sure that Alaskan Road Truckers is brought up to a technical level we are happy with. We cannot say that these will be fixed in one patch, or even two, but incremental improvements will be made and we are putting our focus on resolving these key areas sooner rather than later.

This, of course, doesn’t mean we are neglecting other bug reports and issues reported to us. As we continue to update and patch our game, we’ll be fixing other issues alongside working on the bigger things, you’ll be able to see what we’re fixing in each set of patch notes.

In addition to the above, we are working to get the console version of the game for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S complete and ready for release as soon as possible. We will have news to share about this very soon.

We will also be adhering to our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/849100/view/5779865497754063927]content roadmap[/url]. So while we will be working on these issues, we will also be producing content and updates that will expand and deepen the core Alaskan Road Truckers experience. Look out for more news on these updates soon!

[h2][b]Update Testing[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/da4a6138313b37a9cd3e1bab3b0b24e4d87877eb.png[/img]
One of the points we’ve made continuously throughout development of Alaskan Road Truckers is that we haven’t made this game alone. Now the game is out in the world; this is still true.

Your bug reports, issue reports, reviews, and technical reports have helped us to laser focus our work on the things that really matter to the people who matter - you. That’s why we’re asking for your help again, this time in helping us test upcoming updates.

If you’re interested in helping us test updates, please [url=https://discord.gg/7nzKkAVgN4]head over to our Discord server[/url] where you can find details of how to opt in to the beta branch of the game as well as where you can post any issues you encounter. We made the decision to run this initiative using our Discord server as a central hub as it allows us to monitor + track issues, and respond to feedback in real-time, helping us to better work on any issues that may crop up. 

Thank you to everyone who takes part in this - we do test our own patches, but we are a small team so more hands on the testing wheel means more stable patches. 

We’ve got a long road ahead of us and we hope you’ll continue to join us on it. See you out there, truckers!

notes.title: Alaskan Road Truckers Post-Launch Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello truckers!

Tomorrow will see Alaskan Road Truckers launch onto PC. After years of waiting and hard work, we’re ready to send our Alaskan baby out into the world for the very first time. We can’t wait to hear what you think about our game - but before we launch, we’ve got some news for you.

We want you to all know that when you pick up Alaskan Road Truckers, you’re taking a journey with us. That journey doesn’t end on the 18th of October; it’s just beginning, for us, for the game, and for you!

We plan to keep updating Alaskan Road Truckers after it launches, both in terms of patches and bug fixes, but also with new content and stuff to see and do.

Here’s what we’ve currently got planned - it’s time to check out…

[h2][b]The Alaskan Road Truckers Post-Launch Roadmap[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/048e9f55317915b4243d4cd12c6c34f9b849a609.png[/img]
That’s right, we’ve got big plans for Alaskan Road Truckers after it launches, and we want to give you a sneak-peek of what new stuff we’re going to be working on.

So here’s a look at the first few months of Alaskan Road Truckers and what we will be bringing to the PC version!

[i]Please note this roadmap only details updates for the PC version of Alaskan Road Truckers. Console fans - we'll have an announcement for you soon.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/3e6354076017737c955de6673ad6f2fc14280882.png[/img]
[h3]October 2023[/h3]
[list][*]Steam PC launch
[*]Mother Truckers Edition DLC
[*]New badass truck[/list]October is all about launching Alaskan Road Truckers but you’ll also be able to get your hands on the Mother Truckers Edition DLC, giving you exclusive skins and ornaments for your truck as well as a badass new character to play as. The Mother Truckers Edition  DLC will only be available for a limited time only, so grab it fast!

We’ll be adding a brand new truck later in the month to celebrate the launch - something a little…different. More info coming soon!
[h3]November 2023[/h3]
[list][*]Trucking Legend Mode
[*]Skin & Decal Pack[/list]We know you can’t wait to get stuck into the snow so we’ll be adding a brand new game mode where you’ll start in Winter, with few resources, ready to survive in the harsh Alaskan cold. For truckers looking for more of a challenge - this is the one for you.

We’ll also have new skins and decals for your truck, so you can show off more of your style on the wild Alaskan roads.
[h3]December 2023[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/25ce8310b8f04f411b9a4d873e77ca40408e50f0.png[/img][list][*]Ice Road Expansion
[*]Christmas Update[/list]The first major update for Alaskan Road Truckers will be hitting in December, with the release of our Ice Road Expansion. This will add entirely new routes, roads, and missions for you to conquer - all featuring treacherous icy roads that’ll test your trucking skills to the limit.

We’ll also be adding some holiday cheer to celebrate Christmas, watch out for a round guy in red!
[h3]January 2024[/h3]
[list][*]Expanded Country Roads Network
[*]Internal Cab Customization[/list]In the New Year you can expect to get your hands on our brand new update where we’ll increase the amount of small dirt track roads you can drive on. Existing towns will be interconnected with smaller country roads, so you’ll be able to head off the beaten path and forge your own route through the wilderness.

As well as that, we’ll be releasing the Internal Cab Customization update. You’ll already have access to skins, wraps, and decals for the exterior of your truck, but what about the interior? Make your cab your home away from home with unique customization options.
[h3]February 2024[/h3]
[list][*]New Side Quests 
[*]The Trucker Life Update[/list]February will see us launch our New Side Quests update, where new mission types will be added to the game ensuring that you’ve got more to do, see, and haul. 

We’ll also be adding to the survival experience, with new status effects for your trucker like getting ill, diseases, and much more. Surviving as a trucker will be a more robust experience with deeper systems, coming February 2024.

[h3]Alaskan Road Truckers into the Future[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/cbe1a6f45e1a98705fd80a7bff814346cde5ee29.png[/img]
Of course, our plans don’t stop in February but that’s all we can share for now. We’re planning on adding to our game map, extending existing systems, adding mod support, and providing more for you to experience in Alaska. We can’t confirm anything for now - but stay tuned, we’ll announce everything right here as soon as we can!

notes.title: Alaskan Road Truckers - Final Touches and Steam Reviews
notes.content:
Hello truckers!

We’re fast approaching our PC launch date of October 18 and we’ve been working nonstop to take on board all the feedback we received during our playtests and make sure Alaskan Road Truckers is ready to hit the road.

With a couple of days to go - here’s what’s currently happening with Alaskan Road Truckers!

[h2][b]Community Updates[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/6660053d35707d9f6a214285a50df08b1ed7153b.png[/img]
The feedback, bug reports, and other ideas we’ve received from our community has been amazing. We’ve made tons of updates following our recent playtests, here’s some changes our community has requested that we’ve been able to implement already:

[b]Snow markers in the North of the map[/b] - The real Dalton Highway has snow markers to make sure you’re driving on the road when things get a little cold. We enjoyed not being able to see the road when it’s snowing but we decided, after getting some feedback, that this wasn’t enjoyable for everyone. So snow markers are in - you’ll know exactly where the road is, no matter the weather.

[b]Mouse won’t interrupt steering wheel[/b] - During playtests when you nudged your mouse, it would interrupt inputs from steering wheels. This wasn’t actually a bug, in fact it was a setting that was togglable in the options. However, after reports that this was bothering players, we decided to remove the option and make it so that when you’re using a steering wheel, you won’t find it disconnected by mouse movements anymore.

[b]Camera centering[/b] - Some players didn’t enjoy having the camera center itself automatically when driving. So we’ve made it a button instead! If you want to be looking straight ahead, just hit the assigned key and you’ll be staring straight ahead. If not - there’ll be no interruptions.

[b]Where’s the snow?[/b] - The playtest started players near the beginning of Spring. While we don’t want to throw players in at the deep end, we do know that many of you are anxious to get stuck into the colder parts of the year. As a result of this feedback, players will now start a new game at the beginning of Summer, meaning Winter and all its hazards is that much closer.

[b]Force feedback[/b] - One of the key bits of feedback we received was that force feedback was too strong. We don’t want to shake your desk to pieces, so we’ve made improvements to ensure different types of steering wheels have appropriate levels of force feedback.

In addition to those changes, we’ve made tons of fixes, updates, and tweaks to the game. And more will be coming! Our work on Alaskan Road Truckers isn’t finished at launch, we’re going to add to the game, fix bugs, and be working on it before, during, and after the game comes out. So keep your feedback coming - especially after launch. As Frasier Crane says: we’re listening.

[h2][b]Review us on Steam[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/da4a6138313b37a9cd3e1bab3b0b24e4d87877eb.png[/img]
Speaking of feedback, we have a request to make. After you’ve played the game for at least 2-3 hours please leave a Steam review. Steam reviews are critical to a game’s success; the more reviews we get, the more visibility we get, and the more people will see it. The more people see the game, the better we’ll do, and the better we do, the more we can support and expand our game.

Please note we’re not asking for you to leave a positive review. We want you to voice your honest opinion about the game. If you love it (and we hope you will), we want to hear that. If you don’t - then we want to hear that too. 

So if you can, please leave us a Steam review once the game is out and you’ve played it for a few hours. You can always edit your opinion or expand upon it later, should you so wish.

To keep up to date with all the updates and news for Alaskan Road Truckers, head over to our Steam Store page to wishlist and follow Alaskan Road Truckers. Every wishlist helps us in making sure Alaskan Road Truckers is a success.

notes.title: Open Playtest, Day 1 Summary!
notes.content:
[b]Whew! Saturday was something.
[/b]
The first day of the open playtest brought us much-required feedback - and a lot of fixes. We've been fixing the game in real-time, reading and watching you on Discord and on your streams. This is becoming a tradition for us, isn't it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/feadd4c93812a58c7b6053de56e3d715a178a0a7.png[/img]

Moreover, overnight we created a new build with even more fixes and improvements! So if you played at the start of our playtest, here's what has changed.

[list]
[*] Batteries are available at most gas stations and not only in stores
[*] Fixes to invisible bumps on some roads
[*] Fix for the camera prediction resetting itself to "off"
[*] Some traffic fixes (still WIP)
[*] Bugs fixes in Cantwell, Paxson, and Palmer
[*] Fixed the part of the road leading to Prudhoe Bay
[*] More items in stores from the clerks
[*] Invisible road bump fixes
[*] Fix for the crash when you eat certain items from inside the truck
[*] Improved gear 6 and 8 behavior
[*] Some landscape fixes
[*] Day-night lighting improvements
[*] Additional traffic improvements
[*] CB radio loan system fixes
[*] Removed requirement of the engine being off when (de)coupling a trailer
[*] Steering animation fix
[*] Reduction of sliding on some surfaces
[*] AMD GPUs graphic bug fix
[/list]

We also know about many other issues that are in the works. These include:

[list]
[*] Battery depleting too quickly
[*] Newly bought trucks not working properly
[*] Wheel turning speed is too low (ultimately we think we'll go with an option with a slider, but we'll speed it up by default first)
[*] Remaining AI wonkiness
[*] Steering wheel detection problems for some models (try running the game in admin mode, it often helps)
[*] Force feedback being too strong (FFB options in the works!)
[/list]

We might be able to include at least some of those before the playtest is over.

If you want to support us, wishlist Alaskan Road Truckers, follow us, and tell your friends about it.

notes.content:
Hey there, fellow truckers!

We're thrilled to bring you the latest update on our indie gem, Alaskan Road Truckers. It's been an incredible journey developing this game, and your support throughout the beta phase has been nothing short of amazing.

[h2][b]A GRATEFUL HEART[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/0c73b3348cc28f181a8ea57565eab5cc05d2ea61.png[/img]
First and foremost, we want to express our heartfelt gratitude to all of you who participated in the beta testing of Alaskan Road Truckers. Your dedication and passion have helped us shape the game into something truly special. We've been closely monitoring your feedback, and we couldn't be happier to see so many positive reviews pouring in.

[h2][b]PREVIEW HIGHLIGHTS[/b][/h2]
We are thrilled to share some of the standout previews from the beta phase:

[h3][b]Raptor - This New Open-World Survival Simulator is a Trucking RPG that's in the Brutal Wilderness of Alaska[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Minimap.com.au - On The Road Again – Alaskan Road Truckers Preview
[/b][/h3]https://minimap.com.au/2023/09/alaskan-road-truckers-preview/


[h2][b]ALASKAN ROAD TRUCKERS ROADMAP[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/d64c5b75b8ef7188ae79b907837f29dca2e8af6f.png[/img]
Many of you have been asking for a roadmap to show how we’ll continue to support Alaskan Road Truckers after launch. We’re not quite ready to share it, but we are working on one that we can’t wait to share with you. 

We want to support Alaskan Road Truckers for years to come, and we want you to know what we’ve got planned. So keep your eyes peeled - there’ll be a roadmap soon!

[h2][b]SNOW PROBLEM[/b][/h2]
Alaska is a region of the world that has an incredibly varied climate. Most of the game we’ve shown off so far has been from the sunnier end of the year, with blue skies, green from mountain to mountain, and only a hint of snow.

Alaskan Road Truckers isn’t a game only about cruising through sunny days, you’ll have to deal with bad weather, snowstorms, and even avalanches. One of the gameplay features we’ve been making sure is working perfectly in the run-up to launch is blizzards and snow deformation - here are a few pics of how our work is going!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/946582b08dc118120a82267ea323f137053d307c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/b5bb73d6ef6f7106e11650859fdc0d5c1f24136f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/d7be6e382cde5bc468ca4254e78940fa6011d98d.png[/img]
[h2][b]WHEELS AND SHIFTERS[/b][/h2]
Alaskan Road Truckers aims to recreate the experience of living as a trucker. As we always say, you play as a trucker - not a truck. While you’ll be getting out of the cab to eat, shop, refuel, and jerry-rig repairs to your truck, you’ll be spending a lot of your time driving too.

That’s why we want to make sure that you know that steering wheels and shifters will be supported in Alaskan Road Truckers from day one. So if you have the equipment, you’ll be able to use it in our game.

We’re still finalizing exactly how this support will work and will be announcing more details as we get closer to launch. We just wanted to make sure that you all know that steering wheel support is a priority for us.

[h2][b]RELEASING AN INDIE GAME[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/25b1cd800ed5aacf00965356234e941e102eb874.png[/img]
We’re hard at work making sure Alaskan Road Truckers is ready for launch. This means that everyone is super busy fixing bugs, rewriting text, refining gameplay features, and much - much - more.

We are a small team, so everyone pitches in with everything, and being small means we have unique challenges and opportunities. We’re incredibly ambitious with Alaskan Road Truckers, re-creating a huge slice of Alaska filled with hazards, roads, towns, and more. We had modest ambitions when we started making the game, but as we’ve worked on it, our eyes have lifted to the horizon, and we decided to expand our ideas. We’re now confident we’re making a brilliant, expansive game, and we're pretty sure you'll love it when you to play it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/b530f00720ac9a77183fe0889ab7cc0230931487.png[/img]
This has meant our development time has been longer than we initially anticipated. As our scope grew, the game became more complex, meaning more work, bugs, and stuff to fix. Thankfully, we’re nearly there. We know you’ve all been waiting a long time for Alaskan Road Truckers - and your wait is almost over!

One of the brilliant opportunities that comes from being a small team working on an indie game is that we can take on feedback and work on what matters to you - the player. We aren’t a triple-A studio and publisher that requires tons of approvals before we start work, we can get our hands dirty nearly immediately. All this means that we’re not developing the game in isolation, we’re doing it in conjunction with you - and when we release the game on the 18th of October, your feedback will be utterly essential for us. So when the game’s out, if you encounter a bug, a problem, or have an idea - let us know! 

[h2][b]YOUR FEEDBACK MATTERS[/b][/h2]
We can't stress enough how important your feedback has been during the beta phase. Your input has driven numerous improvements and refinements to the game, and we're committed to continuing this collaborative journey with you as we work towards the full release. 
[url=https://discord.gg/7nzKkAVgN4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/1152a2961d90a62354d1a8171a9189be24160d40.png[/img][/url]  

[h2][b]STAY IN TOUCH[/b][/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/849100/Alaskan_Road_Truckers/ 

Thank you once again for your incredible support and dedication to Alaskan Road Truckers. We can't wait to embark on this adventure with you when the full game launches. Until then, stay safe on those treacherous Alaskan roads!

We've got exciting things in store for Alaskan Road Truckers as we approach the final release. Keep an eye out for upcoming updates, new features, and more content that will enhance your experience even further.

notes.title: The Art of Base Upgrades in Alaskan Road Truckers - Devlog no. 6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/1ac8a98bc293a1be10dc132962202cb938fd30d6.png[/img]

Hello truckers! 

Today, we take a different route and present you with an exclusive interview featuring [b]Michał Puczyński, the CEO of Road Studio[/b] and one of the masterminds behind the captivating world of Alaskan Road Truckers!

Michał is a seasoned game developer, and with his expertise, he has delved into various game projects, among them the enthralling [b]Alaskan Road Truckers[/b] and [b]American Motorcycle Simulator[/b]. Passionate about crafting games that balance challenge and reward, Michał has poured his heart and soul into making the Alaskan Road Truckers experience truly exceptional.

[b]In this interview, we will be delving into the realm of a crucial element of the Alaskan Road Truckers gameplay: base upgrades[/b]. We'll explore the diverse array of upgrades available within the game, learn how players unlock different buildings, and uncover the multitude of benefits they offer.

Buckle up, fellow truckers, as we embark on this journey to discover the secrets behind Alaskan Road Truckers'!

[h2][b]THE ART OF BASE BUILDING[/b][/h2]
[h3][i]INTERVIEW WITH MICHAŁ PUCZYŃSKI - CEO OF ROAD STUDIO[/i][/h3]

[i][h3]What’s the stage of the Alaskan Road Truckers' development right now?[/h3] [/i]
[b]We’re in Beta![/b] This means that everything we wanted to produce for the release day is already there. Now we need to tweak it, make sure it’s all placed where it should, add a layer of polish - and we’ll be ready to release it. Mind that it’s not that easy as it sounds. A friend of mine once said that the final 10% is 90% of the work. But so far we’re doing well and it’s all coming together.

[i][h3]What was the idea behind introducing the base building system in Alaskan Road Truckers?[/h3][/i]
It’s the place you can call home. You need one in a game that takes place in a large open world. Somewhere to come back to, to feel safe and sound in etc. And to make it feel not just cozy, but also earned, and truly yours, we added the base development options. You can add parking spaces, facilities, upgrade them, and we are considering adding some method of internal decoration in the future. 

I mean, when you have a world this big, you can endlessly add stuff to it, right? And while we need to have some kind of goal, a line where we say: okay, that’s enough to release it - we have tons and tons of ideas for what we can add next. We surely want to keep the game grow, so the base might get even bigger than it already is.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/0eeca1199f18a4a84b27bd026b616f8e5e2cf139.png[/img]

[i][h3]What are the different types of base upgrades available in the game?[/h3][/i]
You can upgrade pretty much every type of facility, for example - your customization workshop. I’m not sure if I should spoil everything now. I’d like you to discover this stuff yourself.

[i][h3]How do players unlock base upgrades?[/h3][/i]
Okay, so this takes some work. First of all, you need to do some jobs to earn XP. With new levels in three different skill types, you earn points that you can use to unlock perks. Some perks let you build or upgrade your base’s facilities. But having these perks is not enough. You need to afford the upgrades! You can take a loan (which you’ll need to pay off), or you can simply earn by doing jobs. Then, when you’re ready, just sit at your in-game PC, launch the truck management app, and upgrade your base from there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/727635f0970c604d4cfca1bc96aaed0edd175e5a.png[/img]

[i][h3]What are the benefits of upgrading the player's base?[/h3][/i]
Not spoiling that just yet! Let’s just say that they are all connected to your truck(s), their look, their behavior in different conditions, or their shape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/acb2ff635a4efee805aa2741fb8ded7afe12d369.png[/img]

[i][h3]How do the different buildings at the base interact with each other?[/h3][/i]
First of all, there are dependencies. Some buildings or upgrades require having other buildings or upgrades. The progression is quite logical. By analogy, you wouldn’t build a roof without having walls first, right? The connective tissue between the buildings, however, is your truck. Or trucks. This game revolves around you and your trucks. Your base already gives you a place to take care of your personal needs, and you can upgrade it with buildings that improve your trucking.

[i][h3]What are some of the challenges involved in designing and balancing base upgrades in Alaskan Road Truckers?[/h3][/i]
That’s a great question. First of all, you want the player to feel rewarded by upgrading the base, but not necessarily forced to do it at once. There has to be sense of progress, and it has to come quickly enough to not tire you, but late enough so you can appreciate what you already have and long for what you don’t. Secondly, all of the upgrades need to have meaning. They need to introduce something useful, something that expands your experience. And finally, they need to be easy to use, but also organically implemented into the world. We want you to be able to lift your truck to inspect the chassis, but we also want you to do it instinctively. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/24492ffc4484c6b481a57dead6149d7f5edee6bc.png[/img]

[i][h3]What upgrades would you recommend doing first?[/h3][/i] 
The beauty of the game is the freedom that you have, so what I choose isn’t universally the best. But I like to choose the workshop first. It makes repairing your truck cheaper than using workshops in towns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/4f05d422d0d0366af23df5f103e27e85b98eb8d0.png[/img]

[i][h3]How do base upgrades affect the player's ability to customize their truck?[/h3][/i]
Well! Should I tell you everything? I guess I can say something about that. We have lots of skins, decals, paint jobs, and parts that you can put on your truck. Not all of them are immediately available though. I think that’s enough information for now. Discover it yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/af6f7a4e0c2978dc59a12d0d0f5feec021b6434d.png[/img]

[i][h3]What are your plans for base upgrades in the future?[/h3][/i]
I wouldn’t like to commit to anything right now because we have plans for future content, and we’re already working on this, but the selection of base upgrades isn’t 100% certain just yet. I’d personally go with decorations because I like to customize stuff in games. But maybe you could tell me what you’d like to see?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/fa3c33a09364e90be9cdc1133eae5f5e7d990993.png[/img]

[h2][b]STAY IN TOUCH[/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/849100/Alaskan_Road_Truckers/

Stay tuned for future updates as we forge ahead on the roads of Alaska. Until then, buckle up, keep those engines roaring, and prepare for the adventure of a lifetime!

notes.title: ALASKAN TRUCK SIMULATOR CHANGES ITS NAME! NEW GAMEPLAY AND SCREENSHOTS!
notes.content:
Hi Truckers,

When you’re making a game everything needs to be as perfect as possible. Not only in how the game plays, its graphics and sound, but also the game’s name. Sometimes you have time to think - is the game’s name right for what you’re making?

After some long drives and many hours musing on this, we decided to go for a rename. So long, Alaskan Truck Simulator - we’re very proud to introduce you all to…

[h2][b]Alaskan Road Truckers![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/f368cef17ddc0cc42d43b9e82eb5bceb952228b1.png[/img]

To celebrate the name change we in conjunction with our friends at IGN have put together an exclusive work-in-progress look at Alaskan Road Truckers showing an Alaskan summer along with some of the jobs you’ll do as a trucker:

[previewyoutube=P5mnmPtsntc;full][/previewyoutube]

Please do remember this footage was captured using a previous version of the game, we’ve made tons of progress since. Here are some of our latest screenshots, feast your eyes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/43b145de0f5e9a1264cd9a26618bbea1739de8f2.png[/img]

You’ll get to see more of Alaska soon, we’ll be giving you a look at the different regions, seasons, and climates so keep your eyes peeled for future announcements! 

[h2][b]FAQ:[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Why have you changed the name?[/b][/h3]
In Alaskan Road Truckers you aren’t just a truck, you play as a trucker with a focus on life both inside and outside of your vehicle. After all, you’ll be getting in and out of your truck, hitching uploads, fueling up your truck, and maintaining the health of your driver in the Alaskan outdoors. 

We want to make sure you know when you look at our game that it’s something different and unique, so we thought - what are you? You’re a trucker, you go on roads…in  Alaska.

[b]And so Alaskan Road Truckers was born![/b]

As the game has developed, we feel this brand new name better aligned with our ambitions for the game.

[h3][b]What does this mean for the game?[/b][/h3]

notes.title: More animations & more features! - Alaskan Truck Simulator Devlog no. 2
notes.content:
Hi, Truckers,
Thank you so much for the reception of the last [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/849100/view/3641760560653638581?l=english]devlog[/url]. All the positive comments and thumbs-ups are a brilliant motivation for us - thank you so much for everything you have to say and all the support! 

[b]In our second entry in the series, we want to discuss new features, new animations, and reworked locations in the game. So without delay, let's hit the road![/b]

[h2][b]NEW STARTING LOCATION[/b][/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/aee29ec02a90bbde30d4a38c616dcda51d7cff5d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/f15b8dea6da7896b0784f01d397c902b92f8a615.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/58044fd86f021bcac06afcc56faa0edf4642c26a.png[/img]

A few of you probably remember that in the last demo version, the game started in your HQ, where your trucking career began with cooking a meal, gathering necessary equipment, and going to your truck to complete your first assignment. 

Your starting location will now be the lovely riverside settlement where you will get your first job. Take a look at how different it is 👆

With the new location, we’ve also completely changed the tutorial to fit your play style and show all the necessary information while you are playing. In addition, if you need a refresher, all tutorial messages will be available from the pause menu. We redesigned it and added an encyclopedia tab containing all the information necessary to enjoy your game fully. 

[h2][b]REWORKED TERRAIN AND SURROUNDINGS[/b][/h2] 

As stated in our first devlog, we’ve partnered with Tobiasz Piątkowski, a comic book author and art director from Poland, who is our advisor and helps us add more color and authenticity to the world. 
We had already improved the textures of trees, bushes, grass after your initial demo reactions, but with Tobiasz's help we tweaked things such as the color grading or some finer world building details. Alaska feels so much more immersive, but don’t just believe us. Check it out for yourself 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/68617d727339799976ab46228485eb6688682c1e.png[/img]

[h2][b]NEW ANIMATIONS & NEW MAINTENANCE FEATURES[/b][/h2] 

Alaskan Truck Simulator isn't just about sitting around in your truck and completing the next job; it's about survival and being prepared for the unexpected. That's why we wanted to develop the game's animations to help you feel like a real Alaskan trucker. Since our last entry, we have a few more animations to share with you: fixing the fuse box, changing the wipers, and removing road blockades with some cool tools... GROOVY! 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/02dcdbb26bfa4ea8358fb6a71ff3d50bbbcb6de5.gif[/img]

We’ve also added a fuse box under the hood that will require looking after from time to time. So drive carefully and avoid spending too much money on spare parts. 

Our dev team is also working on adding more random events on the road. Stay tuned to hear more on that in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/d2cd6bc9aa020e57213a1fb622fecda65bd9644b.png[/img]

[h2][b]MAP OPTIMIZATION AND PERFORMANCE[/b][/h2] 

Our team is working hard on expanding the current map. The size of the map and the level of detail we’re working with means significant challenges can arise related to performance. As a result, we’re changing textures on the streets, road signs, and settlements open for exploration in Alaskan Truck Simulator. This will help the world to feel much more immersive with enhanced performance across the board. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/8694d2545cf0a5e915cab232990f3a26ef55e7f5.png[/img]

notes.title: Get your hands on the devlog no. 1 - Alaskan Truck Simulator
notes.content:
Hi, Truckers!

It’s been a while since our last news update, but we’re back with new stuff to share. We’ve been super busy, working hard on the bumpy road of game development, and we’ve got a ton of new things to share with you! 

Let’s start our engine and take you on a drive through all the updates for Alaskan Truck Simulator.

[h2][b]New Publisher - Green Man Gaming Publishing![/b][/h2]

We’ve teamed up with [b]Green Man Gaming Publishing[/b] to ensure we realize our dreams for Alaskan Truck Simulator. They’ll be helping and supporting the development of the Alaskan Truck Simulator as we work towards release. 

With past experience working on [b]Model Builder[/b], [b]Filthy Animals[/b], [b]Kainga: Seeds of Civilization, and much more[/b], we’re sure they’ll make the perfect partners for us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/cc06cfde5f4dfefc2a3ced47fbbe62877b7691af.png[/img]

[h2][b]GET YOUR HANDS ON THE WHEEL[/b][/h2]

We want you to feel immersed in Alaskan Truck Simulator - after all, you’re a trucker, not a truck. From pumping gas to turning on your headlights and steering, you’ll be right there as your trucker with your hands on the wheel and your body in the driving seat.

We are also working on balancing the game regarding the weights of the trailers, the maximum speed of every truck, and how they handle different circumstances. Read what has been improved and reworked: 

[h3][b]NEW STUFF - BODY AWARENESS[/b][/h3]

From now on, you can see your hands animations while handling your daily tasks. Also, we want to introduce special character customization from where you can change the look of your driver. See how those features look in the game: 

[previewyoutube=RTE-2cnWU10;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]NEW STUFF - REWORKED GRAPHIC DESIGN AND GAME LOOK[/b][/h3] 

As you probably noticed in the video, there are a few changes to how the game presents itself. You’ll be spending a lot of time in the world of Alaskan Truck Simulator, so we’ve been making sure it looks as authentic as possible. We’ve increased the detail level in many areas, including buildings, trees, road signs, and truck parts.

In addition, we’ve partnered with Tobiasz Piątkowski, a comic book author and art director from Poland, helping us develop more color and authenticity to the world. We want the world of Alaskan Truck Simulator to feel alive, so we’re adding many small touches to help make the wilderness more lived-in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/b010b6c061848ba8d2475d5e81a181c1b6fedea9.png[/img]

[h3][b]NEW STUFF - INTERACTABLE PLACES AND NPC’S[/b][/h3]

Alaskan Truck Simulator isn’t all about sitting behind the wheel, sometimes you’ll need to get out too. That’s why we are [b]designing interiors and authentic places around the map, including stores, and gas stations[/b], so you can take a break or stock up on essentials.

We’ve also [b]added NPCs[/b] in these locations - shops don’t run themselves, after all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/7ff0ff15d9f704a93134c67df4b4414cd461f8c7.png[/img]

[h3][b]OPTIMIZING THE PERFORMANCE[/b][/h3]

Lately, we’ve also been [b]working on the game's performance and stability[/b]. Our internal Quality Assurance team provided much feedback and insights, which we implemented in the game engine. [b]Alaskan Truck Simulator gets better every minute we spend on it, and we will continually be working to improve the feeling and smoothness of the game.[/b] 

At this point, we would also thank you - our beloved community members - for providing the necessary feedback after our demo tests last year and for your continued support on Steam and your ideas there on improving ATS. 

[h3][b]SMALLER IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3]

On top of all of that, we’ve made several small changes that should improve your Alaskan Truck Simulator experience:

[list]
[*] Improved weather and seasonal system
[*] More development of the player’s HQ, including upgrades for the look and functionality of your base
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/54b89d531c1b68c5ee51da7258ee97b4d12229ef.png[/img]

[h2][b]KEEP IN TOUCH[/b][/h2] 

That’s everything from us for now. In the meantime don’t forget to wishlist Alaskan Truck Simulator and hit us up on [url=https://www.facebook.com/alaskantrucksimulator/]Facebook[/url] to keep up to date with everything we’re working on!

notes.title: Truckers Update #2
notes.content:
Greetings, Truckers!

One of the topics you raised recently was the uniqueness of our game. What is it that makes Alaskan Truck Simulator different and worth playing? We’re happy to tell you!

Long story short, it’s what we told you last week: you play as a trucker, not as a truck. But allow us to expound. 

Creating a compelling simulation of the trucker’s profession (not just limited to driving!) was the main focus from the start. We wanted to make you feel like you’re an organic part of the world. Thus, you can exit the vehicle, you need to go and get groceries, cook food, eat, sleep, fix the engine, etc., etc. You even have your own headquarters that feels like home when you reach it after an arduous journey, and that serves as your base of operations. 

Many of these ideas were implemented after we got your feedback, on [url=https://discord.gg/GWmtpZ5b3k]Discord[/url] or here, on Steam, after our initial showing. The game has changed since then, and you’ve had a strong impact on its evolution. We’ve implemented many ideas from you, and we hope to talk about one of them in our next weekly post. 

Also, we’ve put a lot of effort into [b]the weather system[/b]. You could already see in our trailer that we have a simulation of the entire yearly seasonal cycle. But this goes deeper, with [b]different intensity of rain or snow[/b]--which isn’t just for decoration. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/f2ef717fe4aa3aa732144174770b30140661a6fd.jpg[/img]

The weather affects the way you play, not only by changing how your truck drives, but also because if you drive more carefully in winter, you’ll need to prepare more thoroughly for the ride. Tire chains will cost you so you’ll need to plan ahead and spend money. Your fuel usage will change, so you have to account for that. It’s like a system of interconnected vessels which we created to add depth. 

So, if you were wondering what makes our game stand out, we hope you got your answer! We’re putting a lot of effort into making your digital trucker’s life feel like… life.

See you next week! We’ll make sure to answer your comments to the best of our ability.

If you’d like to support us, add our game to your Steam wishlist, and share the page among your friends. 

Also, [url=https://discord.gg/GWmtpZ5b3k]join our Discord[/url] to find more people with similar passions.
